clips.title: CoreWeave业绩超预期并上调全年指引
title_lines: 业绩超预期并上调全年指引
算力需求强劲但资本成本压力上升

subtitles.en: Let's bring in Giluria, head of technology research at D8 Davidson who joins us now to look at these results out of Core Weave.
subtitles.zh: 让我们请来D8 Davidson科技研究主管Gil Luria，他现在加入我们，来看CoreWeave的这些业绩。

subtitles.en: So a beat, it definitely needed a beat, Gil, but was this enough of a beat and enough of a raised guidance?
subtitles.zh: 所以是超预期，它确实需要超预期，Gil，但这超预期的幅度够吗？上调指引的力度够吗？

subtitles.en: The results themselves are very good. The market for selling computers is white hot.
subtitles.zh: 业绩本身非常好。计算机销售市场非常火热。

subtitles.en: Anybody that needs compute is having a hard time finding it, companies like Core Weave that have the ability to deliver computer, getting as high a price as they want right
subtitles.zh: 任何需要算力的公司都很难找到算力，像CoreWeave这样有能力交付算力的公司，现在能要价多高就多高，对吧。

subtitles.en: now. They're selling a lot of their compute short term, which is getting them even better prices.
subtitles.zh: 他们短期出售大量算力，这让他们获得更好的价格。

subtitles.en: That explains the upside to revenue and some upside to profits as well.
subtitles.zh: 这解释了营收的上行空间以及利润的一些上行空间。

subtitles.en: The challenge for Core Weave is the ability to raise more capital to keep going.
subtitles.zh: CoreWeave的挑战在于筹集更多资金以持续经营的能力。

subtitles.en: The dead markets, for most intents and purposes, are shut down, especially at the unsecured level.
subtitles.zh: 市场基本上处于关闭状态，尤其是在无担保层面。

subtitles.en: They can still try to do some smaller, secure debt, which is more limited in scope and still becoming more expensive.
subtitles.zh: 他们仍可尝试做一些规模较小的有担保债务，范围更有限，且成本仍在上升。

subtitles.en: And they're now pivoting to doing equity.
subtitles.zh: 他们现在正转向权益资产。

subtitles.en: Previously, their strategy was to only finance the capital expenditures with debt.
subtitles.zh: 此前，他们的策略是仅通过债务为资本支出融资。

subtitles.en: Now they're also issuing equity. That's something that as investors die, they're going to have to figure out what the delusion is.
subtitles.zh: 现在他们也在发行权益。这是市场参与者需要弄清楚这种错觉是什么。

subtitles.en: So that's the bigger challenge for Core Weave is getting the capital.
subtitles.zh: 因此，CoreWeave面临的更大挑战是获取资本。

subtitles.en: The fact that the compute prices are very high right now, we already knew that.
subtitles.zh: 事实上，目前计算价格非常高，我们早已知道这一点。

clip_research.source_claim: The challenge for CoreWeave is the ability to raise more capital to keep going. The debt markets, for most intents and purposes, are shut down, especially at the unsecured level... And they're now pivoting to doing equity.
clip_research.public_baseline: CoreWeave has repeatedly raised capital across secured debt, convertible notes, senior notes and equity; it completed a $1.5B IPO in March 2025 and has closed multiple large secured debt facilities.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The analyst frames debt markets as effectively shut and equity as a new pivot, while public disclosures show CoreWeave actively closing large secured debt facilities and having already raised equity via IPO.

evidence.fact: Analyst says CoreWeave's challenge is raising capital; unsecured debt markets shut; pivoting to equity.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
